selection.primary: Mean query MSE on independent coefficient-selection tasks after exact minimum-norm least-squares adaptation; no teacher or test access.
selection.proposal_choice: Within each configuration choose one common hard-I from source proposal anchors/checkpoints by mean exact-refit source query MSE. The selected common-I receives independent coefficient-selection score.
selection.hpo: Select one configuration per method using pilot-family/seed mean best selection MSE. Freeze before new confirmation families. Fixed configuration evaluated for all confirmation family/seed pairs.
selection.confirmation: Checkpoint and common-I still selected using local independent coefficient-selection tasks. No search hyperparameters revised using confirmation, teacher or test.
selection.source_data: All methods receive identical source tasks/observations. Hard-I algorithms build eight source-function proposals and choose a common I using the whole source cohort; MSR/MTSR learn a common U directly. Both data use and different computation are disclosed.
selection.numeric_reset: Primary transfer discards every source numeric code/filter/optimizer state and analytically fits fresh target numbers. Also report native MSR nine-step adaptation from its learned initialization separately.
selection.truth: Only shape and three-code budget enter learning. No mask, grouping, kernel positions, active count, permutation or code values.
selection.constraints: Hard-I variants use fixed zero and three freely fitted values with tied negatives; LC/LUT-Q/Yeh adaptations to this dictionary and common-I bank are explicit. MSR/MTSR retain their native real-valued U and three latent dimensions, without argmax.
selection.scope: Native rank1 reproduces author data-generating distribution and dimensions, not archived data/seeds. Hidden16 is a new matched extension. WS-CNN/images and nonlinear DeepSets belong to later benchmark stages.
selection.tests: No software tests or commits. Only required scientific runs, numerical guards and one lint/format pass per code change.

diagnostics: All per-step original proposals, exact-I discovery versus selection, oracle insertion into selector.
Initial sparsity, code usage, source rank, Euclidean projection objective against teacher projection.
Oracle initialization is a retrospective diagnostic only and never enters prospective search.
diagnostic_plan.prospective: New seed, new pilot and six new confirmation geometries. Twelve configurations per searched variant, independent coefficient validation only. Teacher/test closed until all prospective models freeze.

single_changes.bank_dp_late: Only delay nonzero charge: zero through 30%, linear ramp to full charge by 70%.
single_changes.bank_dp_64: Only proposal anchors 8→64, using the same source observations.
single_changes.joint_constant: Shared hard I with independent C_t for all 64 functions inside every consensus round; local vector projector, constant charge.
single_changes.joint_late: Joint constant variant with the same delayed-charge policy.
single_changes.bank_query_edits: Refine bank_dp I by up to 64 exact one-entry edits chosen by source-query after fresh exact support-fit C_t. All positions/zero/groups editable. Validation only selects checkpoint. No extra tuned hyperparameters.

diagnostic_plan.projector_scope: Multitask vector projection is local, not scalar exact DP. No known mask/count/labels or prelearned MSR/Yeh basis. It runs inside training, not as postprocessing of a competitor.
diagnostic_plan.checks: No software tests; scientific diagnostics, numerical guards and minimal lint/figure inspection only.
